definition: Close the position after it has been held a number of bars, the count read from the evidence, and answer the block's own reason code `time`.
boundaries: A stand-in exit until the risk session writes the real exits. The bar count is a number that may move, so this version reads it from the evidence and keeps the make value only as the seed; version 1 held the make value, ignored a moved one and answered a bare Signal, so the host wrote its own word.
recognition: The position closes once it has been open the set number of bars, and the close names this exit with the reason code `time`.

sources.quote: Placeholder blocks are ordinary blocks whose entry says `origin: placeholder` and names the risk session as owner
A block reads every number from `evidence`; `make` only seeds.
